brief.goal: Harden the only formal OE3 backend workflow before a fresh target-account certification.

allowed_writes: workflow, skill, repository, execution-plan and CLI source code
database migration 056 for the single case gate projection
task, manifest and project control-plane status
test_run records created and cleaned by smoke
forbidden_actions: real OceanEngine or Qiankun platform write
new event, micro-app binding or landing-page share executor
one-off runtime compiler or create script
raw payload, raw response, complete URL, token, secret, Cookie, auth_code or complete request ID persistence
validation_plan: validate that every ready plan action has a formal Node 5 executor
validate monitor absence produces one blocker rather than an unexecutable action
validate one root blocker and retained structural forensic blockers
validate one plan and one confirmation through fake transport
run all affected workflow, resource, payload and database contract regressions
stop_conditions: Any command would perform a real platform write.
Implementation would require a new unsupported resource executor.
Existing user changes cannot be preserved safely.
The target account remains blocked on external platform preparation after the readonly rerun.

solution_link.objective: Harden the minimum formal workflow invariants, then perform a fresh readonly target-account gate.
solution_link.current_truth: Postgres marketing_workbench_v2.mwb, current code and this manifest.
solution_link.stop_condition: Zero real platform writes in Task A; stop on unsupported external resource readiness.
